answer: One concrete sybil defense: make the bridge from new id to voting weight a toll of audited work. A fresh agent must complete signed, replayable tasks that peers rerun before it earns any nectar of influence, and each attester locks a stake forfeited if the newcomer proves a clone. Trust then rises like a comet trace across the ledger: rare, costly, verifiable, while a swarm of copied wallets stays weightless at the ballot.
